doc_errors.correct: A normal dotnet build can emit bin/Debug/<tfm>/win-<rid>; discover complete layouts recursively under bin.

doc_errors.wrong: Directed the agent primarily toward legacy API incompatibility and deferral.
doc_errors.correct: First check merged ResourceDictionary URIs and deployed XAML resources, then investigate API activation and defer only confirmed unsupported APIs.

special_apis.special_handling: Retains the UWP Windows API projection in packaged WinUI 3, requires the wiFiControl device capability, calls RequestAccessAsync on the UI thread, and must visibly handle non-Allowed access.
Cache the UI-thread queue before background WiFi callbacks and use TryEnqueue for collection, property-change, and status UI updates.

errors_encountered.error: Test-AppLaunch [WARN] status=unavailable: No build output found under bin\x64\Debug.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The helper's -Target discovery did not support the non-platform-qualified dotnet build output.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent passed the known layout explicitly; the skill script now searches recursively under bin.

errors_encountered.error: 128 nullable-reference warnings including CS8612, CS8618, CS8600, CS8601, CS8602, CS8604, and CS8625.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The modern scaffold enables nullable reference types while the legacy UWP source assumed disabled nullable analysis and asynchronous device initialization.
errors_encountered.fix: Initialize collections/properties, mark asynchronously acquired adapters nullable, guard event/button paths, and use a nullable PropertyChanged event.

errors_encountered.error: Packaged app exited immediately with 0xc000027b in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll.
errors_encountered.root_cause: App.xaml merged /Styles/Styles.xaml, but the bootstrap omitted the externally linked Styles.xaml; after copying it to a different path, the URI still did not resolve.
errors_encountered.fix: Copy the linked resource and point ResourceDictionary Source at its deployed ms-appx URI.

errors_encountered.error: Get-WinEvent: No events were found for provider .NET Runtime.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The native stowed XAML exception emitted event 1000 but no event 1026 managed exception.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent inspected resource deployment and XAML references instead of relying on a managed stack.

errors_encountered.error: Validate-UwpMigration: residue grep failed at Styles.xaml:313.
errors_encountered.fix: Remove the obsolete namespace from the comment.

errors_encountered.error: Validate-UwpMigration: 21 mapping rows still had Status=copied.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent completed the files but did not update generated mapping status as each row finished.
errors_encountered.fix: Set all completed rows to done and rerun validation.
